title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Quoted Stockroom. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Quoted Stockroom
options.thesis: Every control wears its name in straight quotes. What you cannot use is crossed by the hazard stripe.
options.viewport: Ask is a stockroom wall. Nav plates read "ASK" "DOCUMENTS" "TABLES" "GRAPH" "ADMIN". The live citation keeps the zip-tie. A blocked row wears the diagonal stripe.
options.risk: The quotes become a costume and the passage is too small to read.

raised.raise: The stripe is the one diagonal. Every label stays square and level.
Only the live citation wears the zip-tie. Everything else stays in an edge plate.
A refusal is a printed line, not a colored chip.
Every plate sits on the same square grid. The stripe may cross a plate. It never knocks the label off its cell.

options.label: The Yellow Band
options.thesis: One decision per yellow band. The citation is the gate number, monumental. A closed route stays and says so.
options.viewport: Ask is one hanging band. The question is the destination. "Access policy, page 4" is the huge gate number. A refusal remains on the band as closed, not removed.
options.case: The locator is impossible to miss. Weaker at a desk: this is a walk to a gate, and the product cannot let a refusal vanish.
options.risk: Becomes an airport theme and the passage never gets a place to be read.

options.label: The Gravity Garden
options.lineage: rain that falls toward colored clouds
options.viewport: Citations fall toward whichever cloud owns them.
options.case: Members do not work in a gravity garden, and rain hides the sentence.
options.kept: One rule stays level while the rest may bend.

options.label: The Viewfinder
options.viewport: Brackets tighten on the passage. Zebra marks what is overdue.
options.case: A camera overlay is not this desk, and the display fights the text.
options.kept: Only one thing is targeted. The rest stays in the corners.
options.risk: The citation becomes a face in a frame.

options.label: The Phosphor Tube
options.lineage: a green terminal in a dark room
options.viewport: The console is one scrolling transcript. States print themselves.
options.case: This is the chat terminal the product is leaving, and the other rooms disappear.
options.kept: A state is a line of text, not a badge.
options.risk: Ask becomes a prompt, and Documents has no door.

options.label: The Arcade Grid
options.viewport: The question is a tile room. Score sits on the top edge.
options.case: A game is not a citation, and a score is a claim this product does not make.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A chat thread, a left rail, source chips, and a citation drawer, played straight.
canonCard.viewport: Ask is a message list. You type at the bottom. Citations open in a side drawer.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other assistant, by design.
